title: "WHOOP Visualisations"
author: "Monish Pahwa"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

source("util/helpers.R")

# load the master dataset saved by notebook.Rmd
whoop_master <- read.csv(here("data", "whoop_master.csv"))

# make sure date is proper date format
whoop_master <- whoop_master %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) 

# define WHOOP zone colours used consistently across all plots
zone_colours <- c("red" = "#E8453C", "yellow" = "#F5A623", "green" = "#4CAF50")
```

```{r plot-recovery-over-time}
# ── Plot 1: Recovery Score Over Time ──────────────────────
# Shows how recovery changed across the 3 months
# Each dot = one day, coloured by zone (red/yellow/green)
# Dashed line = smoothed trend so we can see overall direction
# Shaded bands show which zone each score falls in

ggplot(whoop_master, aes(x = date, y = score.recovery_score)) +

  # zone bands in background — shows which zone each day falls in
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 0,  ymax = 33,  fill = "#E8453C", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 34, ymax = 66,  fill = "#F5A623", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 67, ymax = 100, fill = "#4CAF50", alpha = 0.1) +

  # zone labels on the right side of the chart
  annotate("text", x = max(whoop_master$date, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = 16,  label = "Red",    colour = "#E8453C", fontface = "bold", hjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = max(whoop_master$date, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = 50,  label = "Yellow", colour = "#F5A623", fontface = "bold", hjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = max(whoop_master$date, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = 83,  label = "Green",  colour = "#4CAF50", fontface = "bold", hjust = 1) +

  # grey line connecting the dots — shows day to day variation
  geom_line(colour = "grey70") +

  # trend line — loess smoothing shows overall direction
  # span = 0.4 means fairly smooth, not too wiggly
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.4,
              colour = "grey30", se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +

  # coloured dots for each day — colour = recovery zone
  geom_point(aes(colour = recovery_zone), size = 2.5) +

  # use our custom WHOOP zone colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = zone_colours, name = "Zone") +

  # date axis every 2 weeks in "Jan 15" format
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%b %d") +

  # y axis 0 to 100 with labels at zone boundaries
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 33, 66, 100)) +

  labs(
    title    = "Recovery Score Over Time",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = trend | Shaded bands = zones",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Recovery Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none"  # zones already labelled directly on chart
  )
```

```{r plot-recovery-vs-sleep}
# ── Plot 2: Recovery Score vs Sleep Duration ───────────────
# Scatter plot — each dot = one day
# X axis = how many hours slept that night
# Y axis = recovery score the next morning
# Question: does more sleep = better recovery?

ggplot(whoop_master, aes(x = total_sleep_hours, y = score.recovery_score)) +

  # each dot = one day, coloured by recovery zone
  # alpha = 0.7 makes dots slightly transparent
  # so overlapping dots are still visible
  geom_point(aes(colour = recovery_zone), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +

  # linear regression trend line (method = "lm")
  # shows the overall direction of the relationship
  # se = TRUE shows grey confidence interval band around the line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "grey30",
              se = TRUE, fill = "grey80", linewidth = 1) +

  # vertical reference line at 7 hours — minimum recommended sleep
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = 7.1, y = 5,
           label = "7hr minimum", colour = "grey50", size = 3, hjust = 0) +

  # use our custom WHOOP zone colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = zone_colours, name = "Recovery Zone") +

  labs(
    title    = "Does More Sleep Lead to Better Recovery?",
    subtitle = "Each dot = one day | Line = trend | Grey band = confidence interval",
    x        = "Total Sleep Hours",
    y        = "Recovery Score (0-100)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r plot-hrv-trend}
# ── Plot 3: HRV Trend Over Time ────────────────────────────
# HRV = Heart Rate Variability measured in milliseconds
# Higher HRV = body is more recovered and adaptable
# Lower HRV  = body is under stress or fatigued
# Question: is HRV improving or declining over 3 months?

ggplot(whoop_master, aes(x = date, y = recovery_heart_rate_variability)) +

  # horizontal dotted line at overall average HRV
  # helps see which days are above or below normal for this person
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(whoop_master$recovery_heart_rate_variability, na.rm = TRUE),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # label the average line with the actual value
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(whoop_master$date, na.rm = TRUE),
           y     = mean(whoop_master$recovery_heart_rate_variability, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5,
           label = paste0("Avg: ",
                          round(mean(whoop_master$recovery_heart_rate_variability,
                                     na.rm = TRUE), 1), " ms"),
           colour = "grey50", size = 3, hjust = 0) +

  # thin grey line connecting all daily HRV values
  # shows the day to day variation (very up and down!)
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # blue smoothed trend line shows the overall direction
  # se = TRUE shows confidence band — wider band = more uncertainty
  # span = 0.3 means relatively responsive to local changes
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.3,
              colour = "#3F51B5", se = TRUE,
              fill = "#3F51B5", alpha = 0.15,
              linewidth = 1.2) +

  # date axis every 2 weeks
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%b %d") +

  labs(
    title    = "Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Over Time",
    subtitle = "Higher = more recovered | Blue line = trend | Dotted = average",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "HRV RMSSD (ms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )
```

```{r plot-dashboard}
# ── Plot 4: Performance Dashboard ─────────────────────────
# Combines 4 key metrics in one view using patchwork
# Top left:     Recovery score over time
# Top right:    HRV trend over time
# Bottom left:  Sleep duration over time
# Bottom right: Monthly zone summary (bar chart)
# This gives Robin a quick overview of all key health metrics

# ── Panel 1: Recovery Score ────────────────────────────────
p_recovery <- ggplot(whoop_master,
                     aes(x = date, y = score.recovery_score)) +
  # zone background bands
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 0,  ymax = 33,  fill = "#E8453C", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 34, ymax = 66,  fill = "#F5A623", alpha = 0.1) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date(-Inf), xmax = as.Date(Inf),
           ymin = 67, ymax = 100, fill = "#4CAF50", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.4,
              colour = "#4CAF50", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = recovery_zone), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = zone_colours) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Recovery Score", x = NULL, y = "Score (0-100)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── Panel 2: HRV Trend ────────────────────────────────────
p_hrv <- ggplot(whoop_master,
                aes(x = date, y = recovery_heart_rate_variability)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(whoop_master$recovery_heart_rate_variability,
                                na.rm = TRUE),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.4,
              colour = "#3F51B5", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(title = "HRV Trend", x = NULL, y = "HRV RMSSD (ms)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── Panel 3: Sleep Duration ────────────────────────────────
p_sleep <- ggplot(whoop_master,
                  aes(x = date, y = total_sleep_hours)) +
  # red dashed line at 7 hours = minimum recommended sleep
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#E8453C", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(whoop_master$date, na.rm = TRUE),
           y     = 7.3, label = "7hr min",
           colour = "#E8453C", size = 2.5, hjust = 0) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.4,
              colour = "#1A237E", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(title = "Sleep Duration", x = NULL, y = "Hours") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ── Panel 4: Monthly Zone Summary ─────────────────────────
# Count how many days fell in each zone per month
# filter NA dates first to avoid NA bar in chart
# sort months correctly using ordered factor
monthly_zones <- whoop_master %>%
  filter(!is.na(recovery_zone)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%              # remove rows with no date → avoids NA bar
  mutate(
    month       = floor_date(date, "month"),
    # create ordered factor so months appear in correct chronological order
    month_label = factor(format(month, "%b %Y"),
                         levels = format(sort(unique(floor_date(date, "month"))),
                                         "%b %Y"))
  ) %>%
  count(month_label, recovery_zone) %>%
  # order zones so red is at bottom, green at top of stacked bar
  mutate(recovery_zone = factor(recovery_zone,
                                levels = c("red", "yellow", "green")))

p_zones <- ggplot(monthly_zones,
                  aes(x = month_label, y = n, fill = recovery_zone)) +
  # stacked bar — each section = days in that zone
  geom_col(position = "stack", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colours, name = "Zone") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Zone Summary", x = NULL, y = "Days") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom")

# ── Combine all 4 panels ───────────────────────────────────
# patchwork syntax:
# | = place side by side
# / = place one above the other
# result: 2x2 grid of plots
(p_recovery | p_hrv) / (p_sleep | p_zones) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "WHOOP Performance Dashboard",
    subtitle = "Dec 2025 → Mar 2026 | Recovery · HRV · Sleep · Zone Summary",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 11)
    )
  )
```
